response.sql: WITH funding_metrics AS (SELECT p.fundflux, AVG((s.boxy - s.boxx) / NULLIF(s.boxx, 0)) AS avg_y_vs_x_difference, SUM(s.aream2) FILTER (WHERE s.aream2 IS NOT NULL AND s.volm3 IS NOT NULL) / NULLIF(SUM(s.volm3) FILTER (WHERE s.aream2 IS NOT NULL AND s.volm3 IS NOT NULL), 0) AS area_to_volume_ratio FROM scanspatial AS s JOIN projects AS p ON s.arcref = p.arcregistry WHERE p.fundflux IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.fundflux), compared AS (SELECT *, AVG(area_to_volume_ratio) OVER () AS avg_funding_ratio FROM funding_metrics) SELECT fundflux, avg_y_vs_x_difference, area_to_volume_ratio, area_to_volume_ratio - avg_funding_ratio AS amount_above_average FROM compared WHERE area_to_volume_ratio > avg_funding_ratio;

assumptions.assumption: A funding source's area-to-volume ratio is its total area divided by its total volume, using records with both values present. Missing funding sources and zero denominators are excluded from the relevant calculations.

alternatives.interpretation: The funding source's ratio is the average of each spatial record's area divided by its volume.
